statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail remains elevated after a technology-led U.S. rally and strong NQ session, while live NQ microstructure is unavailable during CME’s scheduled maintenance interval.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. A lower Tail state would require evidence after futures reopen that the prior directional hold gives way to broader retracement or fails to extend.
headline: Elevated Tail carries through the futures maintenance break after a strong technology-led close
body: NQ finished the September 3 session around 29,516 after opening near 29,207, with a 29,583.25 high. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.40% with positive breadth and megacap support as Treasury yields eased. Stress remains extreme ahead of Friday payrolls and amid elevated Middle East oil risk; the current maintenance interval limits fresh structure evidence.

lookbackSummary: Tail was mostly low or WATCH through the first part of the prior 24 hours, then rose to elevated late in the U.S. session as trend-up structure strengthened. The 22:00 UTC prior slot had no published ChatGPT assessment and remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: Tail remains elevated into the post-maintenance reopen only if the prior trend resumes with shallow retracements. Overnight risk is forecast to normalize toward WATCH or low absent renewed directional efficiency. Friday payrolls raises Stress sharply; any post-release elevated Tail remains conditional on observed extension or failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: NQ’s September 3 session finished around 29,516 after a 29,207 open and 29,583.25 high, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 1.40% with positive breadth. CME maintenance removes live post-close structure, so Tail stays elevated without a further increase.
drivers: Strong NQ session closed below but near the upper range
Nasdaq breadth and megacaps were broadly positive
CME 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance removes live structure
Friday payrolls and Middle East oil risk keep Stress extreme

forecast.analysis: After Globex reopens, elevated Tail persists only if the prior trend resumes with shallow pullbacks or repeated high retests. A broader retracement or failed high retest would weaken the one-way carry.
drivers: Prior technology-led cash close remains the reference

forecast.analysis: Late-evening Tail remains elevated at the threshold only if the reopened market keeps directional efficiency. Two-sided rotation away from the prior high would shift the regime toward normalization.
drivers: Failed high retest would reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: By 00:00 UTC the base case moves to WATCH as the U.S. impulse ages. Renewed extension after failed retracements would challenge that normalization; balanced trade would reinforce it.
Overnight Tail stays at WATCH. Without fresh evidence of shallow pullbacks or persistent high-holding, the likely structure is less directional while event Stress remains high ahead of payrolls.
drivers: No future path treated as observed

forecast.analysis: Asian-session risk eases another step as current directional evidence ages. A sequence of failed countertrend moves would raise Tail; successful retracements would keep the regime mixed.
drivers: Failed countertrend attempts would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The forecast remains WATCH in lower-liquidity trade. Tail rises only if renewed trend efficiency survives counter-swings; otherwise the post-U.S. move is expected to become more two-sided.
Approaching Europe, Tail remains WATCH because the prior U.S. trend is no longer sufficient evidence by itself. Fresh Europe-session continuation or rejection becomes the key structural checkpoint.
drivers: Fresh structure must confirm the prior U.S. trend

forecast.analysis: Pre-Europe Tail drops to low in the base case as the prior cash impulse is distant and no future continuation can be assumed. Stress stays extreme because payrolls remains unresolved.
drivers: Distance from the prior cash-session impulse

forecast.analysis: Early European trade is forecast low Tail unless a new one-way structure forms. Cross-asset confirmation from yields, oil and technology would matter only alongside observed NQ persistence.
drivers: Cross-assets matter only with observed NQ persistence

forecast.analysis: Europe-open transition lifts Tail back to WATCH as liquidity increases. A directional break with weak retracement would raise concern; a failed break would support mixed conditions.
European morning Tail remains WATCH. The key path is whether overnight movement develops persistent extension or instead rotates broadly before the U.S. data window approaches.
drivers: Pre-U.S. data positioning begins to matter

forecast.analysis: Tail edges higher within WATCH as the payroll window comes closer, but the event itself is not Tail evidence. Only observed directional efficiency before the release would justify a higher state.
drivers: Event importance raises Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: Pre-release Stress rises sharply while Tail remains WATCH. Market positioning may increase whipsaw risk, but hypothetical alignment after payrolls is not counted as already observed.
drivers: Payroll result is still unknown at the cutoff

forecast.analysis: One hour before payrolls, Tail reaches the top of WATCH. The relevant checkpoint is whether pre-release NQ structure is already one-way; absent that, event importance primarily raises Stress.
drivers: Pre-release one-way structure is the Tail checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Payrolls is scheduled for 12:30 UTC. Tail stays WATCH at the release hour because the result is unknown at this cutoff; any higher state depends on the subsequently observed price path and retracement quality.
drivers: Post-release path, not the release itself, determines higher Tail

forecast.analysis: The post-release forecast is elevated only conditionally: persistent extension, failed retracements or extreme-holding after payrolls would support this score. Orderly price discovery with meaningful counter-swings would reduce Tail quickly.
drivers: Failed retracements or extreme-holding would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The first full post-release U.S. hour carries elevated conditional Tail if a directional second leg develops and cross-assets confirm it. If the initial move retraces materially, the score should normalize despite high Stress.
drivers: Meaningful retracement would invalidate elevated Tail

forecast.analysis: Early U.S. cash trade remains conditionally elevated because an opening-auction continuation after payrolls can deny mean reversion. A failed open extension or wider pullbacks would argue for a lower state.
drivers: Opening-auction shallow pullbacks would be material Tail evidence

forecast.analysis: Tail remains elevated only if the cash-session move continues to extend after failed retracements. Divergent semiconductors, softer breadth or yield reversal would weaken directional conviction.
Midday Tail is conditionally elevated but lower than the open window. Persistence near session extremes would keep risk elevated; broader two-sided rotation would reduce it toward WATCH.
Afternoon Tail returns to WATCH in the base case as event repricing matures. A delayed second leg remains the main conditional upside risk, especially if retracements repeatedly fail.
Power-hour Tail stays WATCH. New session-extreme holding with aligned breadth and megacaps would raise it, while stable cross-assets and successful retracements would keep the state contained.
Into the Friday cash close, Tail remains WATCH in the base path. A close pinned near an extreme after repeated failed pullbacks would be the main reason for a higher late-session state.
drivers: Repeated failed pullbacks would raise late-session Tail
Successful mean reversion would support WATCH

forecastDetail.comment: Current slot: strong session evidence supports elevated Tail, but CME maintenance removes live post-close confirmation.
Elevated Tail persists only if the reopened market resumes the prior trend with shallow pullbacks; broader retracement lowers it.
Threshold-elevated Tail requires continued directional efficiency; two-sided overnight rotation would normalize the state.
WATCH reflects an aging U.S. impulse; renewed failed retracements would be the main upside Tail condition.
Overnight WATCH assumes no fresh one-way evidence; payrolls keeps Stress high.
Asian-session WATCH depends on retracement quality, with failed countertrend moves the main conditional Tail amplifier.
